description: Sewer Nodes is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. Approximate locations of existing nodes in the sanitary sewer system owned, operated and maintained by Pierce County PWU-Sewer and Water Utilities Division as well as the private sanitary sewer pipelines that connect into the Pierce County system. Please read metadata ( for additional information. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The table has 23 columns. The portal shows 2026-07-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
